reasons.plausibility: The proposed influence of SRO on dislocation motion and mechanical properties aligns well with current understanding of FCC high-entropy alloys.
reasons.testability: The plan to quantify SRO via advanced characterization and correlate it to measured mechanical responses provides a clear path for potential falsification.
reasons.usefulness: Identifying the role of SRO in property variations is highly relevant and offers practical guidance for alloy design and optimization.
